text:
Conclusion: C, no contract formed. Costco's confirmation was expressly conditional on Rainmaking accepting the $50-per-thousand loading charge, so under UCC § 2-207(1) it is a counteroffer, and Rainmaking never assented to it. The shared note is wrong: § 2-207(2) treats additional terms as proposals only when the response is a definite acceptance, and an expressly conditional response is not one, so no binding deal including the loading charge arises.

CONFIDENCE: 70
